messages:
Diego Alvarez: Hey team, quick onboarding hijack  trying to add my partner to medical+dental. I started 2024-06-03 and did initial elections but the UI only shows spouse/child. Is there an extra step for domestic partners? Also worried about payroll timing my first paycheck posted already.

Rae (People Ops): Welcome Diego! Yes we support domestic partners. We require a signed domestic partner affidavit + one proof of shared residence (recent lease, mortgage, or a utility/bank stmt showing both names or same address). No notarization required. I'll DM the affidavit PDF. If you submit within 30 days we can request retroactive coverage to your start date. Note payroll cutoff details below.

Priya (Benefits): Hi Diego  send docs to benefits@redwood.com. Put "DOMESTIC PARTNER" in the subject and add your desired effective date (e.g., 2024-06-03). Carriers differ on retro; if they allow it we'll process retro. If not, coverage will follow carrier effective rules.

Diego Alvarez: Thx. About payroll: will deductions be prorated or will I see a big one-time deduction? My first check didn't have any benefit deductions.

Rae (People Ops): Tagging @PayrollBot to clarify standard behavior for mid-cycle retro enrollments.

PayrollBot: PayrollBot: Deductions start after enrollment is processed. For retro-approved effective dates, payroll computes a prorated catch-up to cover the earlier period. If the catch-up is large, payroll can split it across the next 2 pay cycles upon request. If the carrier directly bills for retro premiums, Benefits coordinates reimbursement.

Priya (Benefits): Also flag: HSA elections are separate and must be elected in Workday within 30 days. If you want HSA contributions to be retroactive, tell us in the email and we'll coordinate prorated catch-up with payroll.

Diego Alvarez: My partner is on COBRA until 2024-06-15. Should I wait or enroll now?

Priya (Benefits): Enroll now and set your preferred effective date. Once we confirm new coverage we can help terminate COBRA to prevent double-billing. Please attach COBRA docs and write "COBRA" in the subject. Timely docs usually avoid overlap.

Diego Alvarez: Uploaded affidavit + lease + COBRA notice to benefits@redwood.com with subject "DOMESTIC PARTNER + RETRO + COBRA". Appreciate the help.

Priya (Benefits): Received  thanks. We'll validate docs and submit to carrier. If carrier approves retro to 2024-06-03 we'll notify payroll to calculate any prorated premiums. Expect confirmation in 2-3 business days.

Rae (People Ops): Noting payroll cutoff: payroll closes 5pm PT two business days before pay date. If docs arrive after cutoff we may have to wait one extra pay cycle for deductions. We'll monitor and update.

Diego Alvarez: Great, thanks all!
